plotting_plan.title: Reliability-aware lifecycle model overview
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Block Diagram) of the cohort-by-age lifecycle model: inputs (SKUs with component slots, Weibull failure models precomputed into per-age expected failures and drains, regional grid carbon trajectories, demand per tier, reused-part pools) feeding the multi-period LP with decisions buy / keep / cascade (in-place and geographic) / lease / retire, an outer Monte Carlo chance-constraint loop that adds per-region-quarter LC reserve, and outputs X / Y / Z savings and SLO price.

plotting_plan.title: Fleet lifecycle carbon ladder and savings by grid
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Grouped Bar Chart, two panels) of carbon change by component for the failure-blind reuse plan, reliability-aware plan and cascading variants relative to the no-reuse fleet, and of X, Y_naive, Y and Y+Z for clean, mixed and dirty single-grid fleets; reuse pre-existing figure fig1_fleet.png.

plotting_plan.title: Reuse saving versus reused-part failure multiplier
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Line Chart, log-x) of X, Y and Y_naive versus the reused-part failure-rate multiplier from 0.5 to 20, showing graceful degradation of the reliability-aware plan to zero at about 8 and the failure-blind plan crossing zero near 2.1; reuse pre-existing figure p3_reliab.png.

plotting_plan.title: Cascading saving versus old/new GPU batch work per joule
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Line Chart) of Z and Zg versus old/new BATCH work per joule from 0.47 to 1.87, showing break-even near energy parity; reuse pre-existing figure p3_cascade.png.

plotting_plan.title: Reuse saving and carbon price under guaranteed SLOs
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Line Chart, two panels) of Y under guaranteed SLO and SLO carbon price across failure correlation (independent, k=2, k=0.5), SLO targets 1% and 0.1%, and reused-part multipliers 1 and 3; reuse pre-existing figure p4_chance.png.

plotting_plan.title: Node-level sensitivity of the reuse saving
plotting_plan.objective: Visual summary (Horizontal Bar Chart, tornado layout) of the node-level reuse saving on the mixed grid, LC tier, across parameter ranges, led by the CXL throughput multiplier with a 16.6 pp swing; reuse pre-existing figure p1_tornado_mixed_LC_cutoff.png.

introduction_strategy.hook_hypothesis: Datacenter and AI-inference energy and carbon footprints are growing, and embodied carbon of server hardware is a large share of computing's footprint; component reuse in new server designs has been shown to cut cloud emissions.
introduction_strategy.problem_gap_hypothesis: Reuse-based server designs are evaluated at a single point in time under average grid carbon, while operators make sequential multi-year buy/reuse/cascade/retire decisions and reused DRAM and SSDs are aged parts with age-dependent failures; for 8-GPU LLM-inference hosts, operational carbon dominates. Claims are scoped to a modelled three-grid LLM-inference fleet with public and assumed parameters.
search_directions: Find papers quantifying the carbon footprint of computing and datacenters, including embodied versus operational carbon of servers
Find papers on the carbon and energy footprint of large language model training and inference
Find papers proposing low-carbon cloud server designs that reuse DRAM and SSDs or extend hardware lifetime
Find architectural carbon modelling tools and methodologies for embodied carbon of computer systems
Find large-scale field studies of DRAM, SSD and GPU failures in datacenters

related_work_strategy.overview: Investigate four paradigms to show that no prior work jointly optimizes multi-year hardware lifecycle decisions with age-dependent reliability of reused parts for AI-inference fleets.

subsections.subsection_title: 2.1 Low-Carbon Server Design and Embodied-Carbon Accounting
subsections.methodology_cluster: Embodied-carbon models and reuse-based server design
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Identify papers up to 2026-10-21 that model embodied carbon of servers, SSDs and DRAM, and that design servers with reused or second-life components, including evaluation at fleet scale.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: These works evaluate a design at a single point in time and under average grid carbon; they do not model age-dependent failures of reused parts or sequential procurement and retirement.
limitation_search_queries: embodied carbon SSD manufacturing per GB
reused DRAM CXL cloud server carbon
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We embed reuse-based SKUs in a multi-period lifecycle model with per-age reliability, spares and repair drains, and evaluate across grids.

subsections.subsection_title: 2.2 Field Reliability of Memory, Storage and Accelerators
subsections.methodology_cluster: Large-scale failure studies of DRAM, flash and GPUs
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find field studies up to 2026-10-21 of DRAM errors and their dependence on age, SSD/flash failures and replacement rates, GPU and accelerator failures in large AI clusters, and silent data corruption.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Field studies report failure statistics but do not translate them into the carbon implications of reusing aged parts.
limitation_search_queries: DRAM errors field study age effect
GPU failures large-scale training cluster interruptions
silent data corruption at scale processors
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We calibrate age-dependent Weibull hazards from such statistics and propagate them into carbon via spares, drains and SLO headroom.

subsections.methodology_cluster: Temporal and spatial workload shifting for carbon
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find carbon-aware scheduling, workload shifting and elastic scaling papers up to 2026-10-21 that exploit grid carbon variation.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: These systems treat the hardware fleet as fixed and optimize when and where work runs, not which hardware to buy, reuse, cascade or retire.
limitation_search_queries: temporal workload shifting carbon emissions cloud
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We optimize the fleet itself across its lifecycle, including geographic cascading of old hardware to clean grids, complementary to scheduling.

subsections.subsection_title: 2.4 Heterogeneous LLM Serving and Tiered Memory
subsections.methodology_cluster: LLM serving systems, heterogeneous GPUs and CXL memory tiering
subsections.sota_investigation_mission: Find LLM serving systems, KV-cache management, heterogeneous-GPU serving, CXL memory pooling and tiering, and DNN fault-injection studies up to 2026-10-21.
subsections.limitation_hypothesis: Heterogeneous serving optimizes cost or throughput, not lifecycle carbon; CXL tiering studies do not consider aged reused DIMMs; DNN fault studies do not target the KV cache on reused memory.
limitation_search_queries: LLM serving paged attention KV cache memory management
heterogeneous GPU LLM serving cost efficiency
phase splitting LLM inference different GPUs
transparent page placement CXL tiered memory
error propagation DNN accelerators fault injection
subsections.bridge_to_our_method: We quantify when cascading old GPUs saves carbon and prepare measurements of KV-cache placement and error tolerance on CXL-like reused memory.

content_bullets: State the gap: reuse evaluated at a point in time vs sequential multi-year decisions with aging reused parts (idea.md Problem Statement).
Summarize the model: cohort-by-age LP, Weibull reliability, harvest pools, cascading incl. geographic, chance-constrained SLO headroom (idea.md Methodology).

Report key numbers from experimental_log.md: X 5.766% clean vs 0.675% mixed; Y 0.775% vs X 0.848% fleet; failure-blind crossing near multiplier 2.1 vs reliability-aware stopping near 8; cascading break-even near energy parity; SLO price up to 0.82% with Y 0.812% under 0.1% target and strong correlation.
State that GPU throughput, power and CXL slowdown were placeholders and measurements are prepared.

subsections.subsection_title: Fleet State, Decisions and Flow Conservation
content_bullets: Define cohorts (s, tau, r, a, t) and the three SKUs new_gpu, green_gpu, old_gpu from idea.md and the SKU bullet of experimental_log.md.
Present the flow-conservation equation from idea.md with buy, retire and cascade (in-place and geographic) terms; forced retirement at maximum age.
Describe reused-part harvest pools with external supply and 0.9 screening yield.

Formalize the Weibull hazard and AFR calibration from idea.md; delayed renewal for replaced parts; precomputed expected failures, drains, spares per age keep the LP linear; proportional-hazards multiplier m for reused parts.
Give the capacity constraint with throughput, CXL multiplier, utilization cap and LC headroom multiplier.

Give the lifecycle carbon objective from idea.md: amortized embodied with stranded remainder, idle-plus-dynamic operational power times PUE times declining grid CI, spares and logistics, lease and shipping; epsilon-constraint for cost.
State the cut-off convention and that alternatives are evaluated.
Model concurrent drained LC nodes as M/G/infinity occupancy: Poisson (independent) or negative binomial with dispersion k (correlated).

Describe the outer loop: solve, sample capacity per region-quarter, add demand minus epsilon-quantile of capacity to installed-capacity reserve, re-solve until P(short) <= epsilon; reserves grow monotonically.
State validation by independent replay with 50,000 samples.

Describe node-level, pilot and reference fleet scenarios from experimental_log.md (24 quarters, three grids with base CI 40/250/650 gCO2e/kWh, demand growth, initial fleet of about 1,750 hosts, pools).
Present component parameters: embodied carbon, Weibull shapes, AFRs, drain times; GPU AFR 0.0868 derived from a 54-day interruption report on about 16,384 GPUs.
State parameter provenance: placeholders for GPU throughput, power and CXL slowdown; all others assumptions with swept ranges.
Define E0, E1, E2a, E2b, E3, E3g and metrics X, Y_naive, Y, Z, Zg from idea.md.

Report that the 36-node pilot MILP hit a 300 s limit while the LP relaxation matched within about 0.05 pp and was scale-invariant; reference ladder solves in about 4 s; 40 tests including a hand-calculated case.
Describe the prepared GPU measurement methodology (serving benchmark, KV offload local vs remote NUMA, KV fault injection with none/SECDED/checksum) as not yet executed.
Use the node-level table: operational about 91% of a new host's lifecycle carbon on the mixed grid; reuse cuts node embodied carbon from 8,312 to 2,860 kgCO2e but total by about 6%.
Node-level savings by grid and tier; tornado: CXL multiplier swing 16.6 pp decides sign on mixed grid.
Fleet ladder table and Fig. fig_fleet_carbon_ladder_by_grid: X 0.848%, Y_naive 0.195%, Y 0.775%; by grid X 5.766/0.675/0.103%.
Failure-blind plan loses via 13,104 tCO2e leased capacity vs 530 tCO2e.
Failure multiplier sweep (fig_reliability_breakeven_reused_parts): Y degrades to 0 at about 8; Y_naive crosses zero near 2.1 and reaches -2.251% at 20.
Node failure breakdown: DIMM failures 9.67 vs 5.43 per host, GPU failures dominate drained hours.
Cascade sweep table and fig_cascade_breakeven_energy_efficiency: Z about 0 at 0.70 efficiency ratio; pays near parity; Zg adds 50 to 70% above parity.
Monte Carlo replay of expected-value plans: worst region-quarter P(short) up to 14.5% (independent) and 15.5% (correlated) for reuse plans; region-quarters above 1%.

Chance-constrained results table and fig_chance_constrained_slo: SLO price 0.22 to 0.82%; Y grows from 0.775% to 0.812% (and 0.480% to 0.500% at 3x); validated worst P(short) within targets; 2.6x reserve under strong correlation.

subsections.subsection_title: Robustness: Accounting, Fuzzy Uncertainty, Headroom and Cost
content_bullets: Accounting convention table: Y 0.601 to 1.423% or 0 if reused parts charged as new.
Fuzzy alpha-cuts: Y in [0, 2.638]% at alpha 0 and [0.266, 1.489]% at alpha 0.5.
Headroom and utilization sweep: Y higher at utilization 0.5.
Carbon-cost front: cost-minimal plan +2.6% carbon for -16% cost.

Reuse-based hosts for reserve and lightly loaded capacity; efficient hosts for base load; grid-aware placement of reuse; cascading as cost lever unless near energy parity (experimental_log.md observations).
